title: Swift: portable language foundations and Apple app architecture
summary: 48 detailed lessons from first programs through language mechanisms, reliable systems and independently designed projects.

lessons.title: A Swift source file and its explicit entrypoint
lessons.outcome: Model a three-level capacity calculation and explain every intermediate value.
lessons.lab: Compute the capacity of three shelves holding eight books each.
lessons.verification: Hello, Swift appears before the lesson marker. The computed seat count is 24.

lessons.title: Constants, variables and static types
lessons.outcome: Choose units and types for a small measurement model.
lessons.lab: Compute a mean from an integer total and count using a deliberate conversion.
lessons.verification: The accumulator becomes 8 while the fixed amount remains 4. Integer division yields 3; floating division yields 3.5.

lessons.title: Numeric limits and intentional arithmetic
lessons.outcome: Choose a numeric representation and rounding policy for a price calculation.
lessons.lab: Write checked quantity addition that returns an explicit rejected outcome.
lessons.verification: 255 plus one reports overflow and a wrapped partial result of zero. The floating result meets the stated tolerance and the decimal fixture retains decimal intent.

lessons.title: Strings, Unicode and collection indices
lessons.outcome: Design a text-field limit and document whether it counts bytes or visible characters.
lessons.lab: Write a function returning the first Character as an optional value.
lessons.verification: Both spellings contain one Character but differ in UTF-8 bytes. The split preserves the emoji as a complete Character.

lessons.title: Optionals and honest absence
lessons.outcome: Model an optional measurement whose absence must survive serialization and reporting.
lessons.lab: Write a parser accepting only present nonnegative integers.
lessons.verification: A present zero remains distinct from nil. Parsing produces an optional and malformed text is absent.

lessons.title: Branches, switch and exhaustive reasoning
lessons.outcome: Replace a broad default in an enum switch with explicit cases and explain the maintenance benefit.
lessons.lab: Write a three-way classifier for negative, zero and positive quantities.
lessons.verification: 59 retries, 60 passes and 101 is invalid. The early exit excludes missing and empty values before the valid path.

lessons.title: Loops, invariants and safe traversal
lessons.outcome: Design a bounded retry loop and explain both its invariant and its stop condition.
lessons.lab: Implement a first-match search with an optional result.
lessons.verification: The total is 12 and the empty total is zero. The first 8 appears at offset 1 and 9 is absent.

lessons.title: Functions, argument labels and value contracts
lessons.outcome: Choose return values or inout for an API and justify who owns state changes.
lessons.lab: Write a pure function normalizing a quantity without mutating its caller.
lessons.verification: Labels show which dimension each argument supplies. The caller explicitly grants mutation and observes 5.

lessons.title: Arrays and copy-on-write value semantics
lessons.outcome: Explain what changes when array elements are mutable class instances.
lessons.lab: Build a filtered array without changing the source.
lessons.verification: Appending to the copy leaves the original unchanged. Reserving twenty slots creates no logical elements.

lessons.title: Dictionaries, sets and stable hashing
lessons.outcome: Design a custom Hashable key using only stable identity fields.
lessons.lab: Build a unique sorted list of accepted inventory names.
lessons.verification: Pear is present with zero and apple is absent. Duplicate red is not inserted and sorted output is deterministic.

lessons.title: Tuples, enums and associated values
lessons.outcome: Choose tuple or named enum/struct for a reusable public API and explain the tradeoff.
lessons.lab: Model loading, ready and failed states with an enum.
lessons.verification: Named tuple fields expose the accounting relationship. Each outcome exposes only its own meaningful payload.

lessons.title: Structures and controlled value mutation
lessons.outcome: Choose a value model for an editable form and explain how cancel can restore an earlier snapshot.
lessons.lab: Build a bounded counter with private mutation.
lessons.verification: Reserving from the copied inventory does not change the original. Rejected requests retain the previous valid stock.

lessons.title: Classes, identity and shared state
lessons.outcome: Explain whether a shared class needs synchronization before use from concurrent tasks.
lessons.lab: Choose class or struct for a shared connection coordinator and a coordinate value.
lessons.verification: Both names observe the same increment. Two fresh counters have equal state but distinct identities.

lessons.title: Properties, observers and derived state
lessons.outcome: Choose an explicit method instead of a setter for a state change with validation and failure.
lessons.lab: Build a value model with one stored unit and a documented converted view.
lessons.verification: Area changes with width without a separately updated area field. The getter and setter translate between temperature scales.

lessons.title: Closures, captures and transformation pipelines
lessons.outcome: Choose a named function or closure for a reusable domain transformation and explain readability and capture policy.
lessons.lab: Write a function accepting a transformation closure.
lessons.verification: Map creates transformed values while retaining the original array. The explicit capture list retains factor 2 for the closure.

lessons.title: Foundation project: an honest inventory importer
lessons.outcome: Design a reusable result that retains safe line-specific reasons without storing raw sensitive input.
lessons.lab: Produce a sorted text report with accepted totals and rejected count.
lessons.verification: Pear totals 6 and apple totals 3. The valid zero remains present while three records are rejected.

lessons.title: Protocols and behavioral substitution
lessons.outcome: Choose a dependency worth abstracting in the importer and explain why a protocol helps.
lessons.lab: Define a protocol for a deterministic label formatter.
lessons.verification: The consumer calls the pricing capability without needing its storage details. Two conforming policies produce different valid prices.

lessons.title: Generics and relationships between types
lessons.outcome: Choose generic or existential abstraction for an API that must preserve concrete result type.
lessons.lab: Create a generic immutable triple with a rotation operation.
lessons.verification: One implementation preserves Int and String results. Swapping retains the same concrete element type.

lessons.title: Associated types, opaque results and existentials
lessons.outcome: Choose opaque output or existential storage for an API and document the preserved relationships.
lessons.lab: Write a generic transformation preserving the producer item type.
lessons.verification: The generic consumer knows the produced value is an Int. The caller uses sequence behavior without naming the concrete array type.

lessons.title: Collection protocols, laziness and algorithm costs
lessons.outcome: Choose lazy or materialized processing for a large input and explain repeatability and memory costs.
lessons.lab: Write a generic sum over Sequence where the element type is suitable.
lessons.verification: The slice starts at index 1 while traversal still produces two elements. The lazy recipe produces 20 and 30 when consumed.

lessons.title: Throwing functions and explicit result values
lessons.outcome: Choose Optional, throws or Result for three APIs and explain each semantic distinction.
lessons.lab: Write a throwing validator for an inventory record.
lessons.verification: Three is accepted and a negative quantity is rejected. The stored outcome retains a QuantityError.

lessons.title: ARC, weak references and retain cycles
lessons.outcome: Choose weak or unowned for a relationship and justify the lifetime guarantee required.
lessons.lab: Design a weak delegate relationship.
lessons.verification: The weak observer becomes nil after the last strong reference is removed. The child survives independently without retaining its parent.

lessons.title: Codable and validated data boundaries
lessons.outcome: Plan migration of a renamed field without discarding existing saved records.
lessons.lab: Write a decoder that validates before returning a trusted item.
lessons.verification: The modeled fields round-trip through JSON. Valid JSON can still describe an invalid item.

lessons.title: Files, URLs and owned persistence
lessons.outcome: Design a durable app save with atomic replacement and a recoverable previous version.
lessons.lab: Persist a Codable value in a temporary file and validate after reading.
lessons.verification: The UTF-8 bytes round-trip in a uniquely owned location. The two URLs carry different location schemes.

lessons.title: Dates, calendars and elapsed time
lessons.outcome: Design storage, display and duration-measurement policies for an appointment app.
lessons.lab: Build a report from fixed timestamp fixtures.
lessons.verification: The elapsed interval is 5,400 seconds. Both strings represent the same instant.

lessons.title: Swift packages and module boundaries
lessons.outcome: Add a new target only when it creates a useful dependency boundary and document that direction.
lessons.lab: Run swift test and the journey-demo executable.
lessons.verification: The pure kernel is suitable for a reusable library. Presentation is independently testable.

lessons.title: Testing behavior with the prepared package
lessons.outcome: Create a verification plan distinguishing unit, package, UI and device evidence.
lessons.lab: Add a real JourneyCore test for rejected negative quantity.
lessons.verification: Normal and boundary values satisfy the clamp contract. The zero case catches the wrong default and clamping is idempotent.

lessons.title: Async functions and suspension points
lessons.outcome: Identify suspension points in an app load operation and explain what state may change around them.
lessons.lab: Write an async adapter that returns a validated domain value.
lessons.verification: The awaited result is 8. The async boundary preserves both the valid result and the domain error.

lessons.title: Task groups and bounded parallel ownership
lessons.outcome: Choose a concurrency bound for an I/O workload and explain its resource basis.
lessons.lab: Implement bounded admission for a small list with at most two outstanding children.
lessons.verification: Sorted results are deterministic despite unspecified completion order. No admitted children produces the identity result zero.

lessons.title: Cancellation and cleanup in asynchronous work
lessons.outcome: Design a receipt distinguishing success, confirmed cancellation and unknown outcome.
lessons.lab: Write a bounded processing loop with cleanup on cancellation.
lessons.verification: The task acknowledges cancellation and its completion is awaited. This task still returns 9 because its body does not check cancellation.

lessons.title: Actors and serialized state ownership
lessons.outcome: Design a reservation state machine for an operation requiring external I/O before commitment.
lessons.lab: Implement a bounded actor-owned queue with explicit admission.
lessons.verification: All twenty increments are retained. The second reservation is rejected without making stock negative.

lessons.title: Composition project: an actor-owned import ledger
lessons.outcome: Design a durable adapter and document what actor isolation alone cannot guarantee.
lessons.lab: Add a read-only receipt lookup that never re-executes work.
lessons.verification: A repeated operation returns its receipt without applying again. A changed payload is rejected and prior state remains intact.

lessons.title: Sendable and strict concurrency boundaries
lessons.outcome: Design data exchange between a UI model and a background actor using immutable snapshots.
lessons.lab: Replace a shared mutable result class with a sendable value result.
lessons.verification: The task receives immutable value data and returns 6. The parent owns result aggregation and sorts it deterministically.

lessons.title: AsyncSequence, streams and bounded buffering
lessons.outcome: Choose lossless backpressure or deliberate dropping for a real event source and explain cleanup on cancellation.
lessons.lab: Build a finite event stream with explicit completion ownership.
lessons.verification: The finite stream totals 5 and terminates. The newest-one policy retains 2 and drops the older buffered value.

lessons.title: Unsafe memory, buffers and scope-limited access
lessons.outcome: Write an interoperability checklist covering ownership, alignment, initialization and error reporting.
lessons.lab: Wrap a scoped read-only buffer operation behind a safe function contract.
lessons.verification: The result escapes as an integer while the borrowed pointer does not. An empty buffer is valid to inspect by count.

lessons.title: Performance, copy costs and complexity
lessons.outcome: Write a measurement plan covering workload, correctness, optimization mode and allocation evidence.
lessons.lab: Compare repeated array scans with one built Set under the same identity policy.
lessons.verification: The last-element search performs four comparisons. The index preserves four identities and answers membership.

lessons.title: Property wrappers and reusable access policy
lessons.outcome: Choose a wrapper or explicit validation method based on whether assignment can fail meaningfully.
lessons.lab: Create a wrapper with an explicit normalization policy for a local display field.
lessons.verification: Assignments are clamped into zero through ten. A valid interior value is unchanged and the projection exposes the range.

lessons.title: Result builders and declarative composition
lessons.outcome: Explain why a domain-specific builder may be clearer or less clear than an ordinary array literal.
lessons.lab: Build a small report declaration using the existing builder.
lessons.verification: Two expressions become an ordered array of sections. The conditional contributes its section when true.

lessons.title: App architecture: a portable domain core
lessons.outcome: Draw the dependency direction among core, persistence adapter, view model and SwiftUI views.
lessons.lab: Build and test JourneyCore before opening the Apple app.
lessons.verification: The transformed item changes completion while retaining the original value. Completion changes do not manufacture a new identity.

lessons.title: SwiftUI state, bindings and a single source of truth
lessons.outcome: Decide whether a piece of state belongs to the view, model or domain core and justify its lifetime.
lessons.lab: Run JourneyApp and edit a title through its real binding.
lessons.verification: The label follows the stored completion state. Changing completion changes the derived label while retaining the title.

lessons.title: Navigation, stable identity and deep-link validation
lessons.outcome: Design a restoration format for navigation without storing view instances or private payloads.
lessons.lab: Run JourneyApp and navigate by stable item identity.
lessons.verification: The admitted scheme and host resolve to item one. Unrelated schemes, missing identity and unlisted actions are rejected.

lessons.title: App persistence, migrations and recoverable saves
lessons.outcome: Design a version-one to version-two migration with backup, rollback and verification steps.
lessons.lab: Inspect JourneyApp save and load errors with an owned test file.
lessons.verification: The supported envelope round-trips with two titles. The unsupported document is rejected without modifying its payload.

lessons.title: Networking, loading states and stale-result protection
lessons.outcome: Design a URLSession boundary with explicit FoundationNetworking import on Linux, request timeout, size bound and schema validation.
lessons.lab: Implement a deterministic fake transport returning success and failure values.
lessons.verification: The matching generation updates current state. The stale response cannot overwrite the newer value.

lessons.title: Accessibility, localization and inclusive interaction
lessons.outcome: Create a manual accessibility acceptance checklist with concrete observations and retained defects.
lessons.lab: Run JourneyApp using keyboard navigation and VoiceOver on macOS.
lessons.verification: The label communicates completion without relying on color. Display text changes while identity remains stable.

lessons.title: UIKit and AppKit integration boundaries
lessons.outcome: Document coordinator ownership, delegate cleanup and platform-specific API availability.
lessons.lab: Inspect and build SelectableText.swift in the Apple project.
lessons.verification: The same value is not assigned twice. The portable kernel exposes a deliberate state transition.

lessons.title: App tests, simulator evidence and signing
lessons.outcome: Prepare a release note listing platform, SDK, destination, test results and remaining device/signing limitations.
lessons.lab: Generate JourneyApp, list destinations and run its provided test scheme on an available simulator or macOS destination.
lessons.verification: Domain and package evidence do not imply UI or device qualification. Save/reload remains an explicit incomplete gate.

lessons.title: Multiplatform design and deployment contracts
lessons.outcome: Create a platform support matrix listing compiled, executed and manually inspected surfaces separately.
lessons.lab: Build JourneyCore on a prepared Linux Swift environment and separately build JourneyApp on macOS.
lessons.verification: The same domain summary works without a UI framework. The Linux capability set does not invent SwiftUI support.

lessons.title: Capstone: an offline-first study planner
lessons.outcome: Deliver a project README with architecture, actual platform evidence, accessibility observations, recovery policy and one independently implemented extension.
lessons.lab: Build and test JourneyCore, then run the complete JourneyApp on a prepared Apple destination.
lessons.verification: One of two uniquely identified items is complete. The update retains identity and the prior snapshot.
